description: This source file implements an AI conversation bot that integrates various functionalities such as weather retrieval, restaurant recommendations, and graceful termination. It sets up the pipeline, external tools, and transport mechanisms, registers external functions for the bot's use, and defines the main run logic for handling client connections and message processing.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Defines the schema for external functions the bot can call, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Defines the set of tools (both standard and custom) available to the language model.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero model used for audio processing.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Parameters for voice activity detection, such as stop_secs.

classes.name: EndTaskFrame
classes.description: Frame representing the end of task state in the processing pipeline.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame indicating an LLM (Language Model) run in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline for handling audio and message flow.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution and lifecycle of a pipeline, including start, cancel, and run.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task consisting of a pipeline and its parameters.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing LLM interactions and conversation state.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs for aggregating context from user and assistant roles.

classes.name: FrameDirection
classes.description: Enum indicating the direction of a frame in the pipeline (upstream or downstream).

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Arguments or configuration for running the pipeline and server.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Utility function to instantiate the correct transport based on configuration.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: Client for interacting with Gemini Live LLM service, including function registration.

classes.name: FunctionCallParams
classes.description: Parameters passed when calling an external function, including arguments and callback.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract base class for various transport implementations (WebSocket, Daily, etc.).

classes.name: TransportParams
classes.description: Generic parameters for setting up different transport layers.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Transport parameters specific to Daily transport implementation.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Transport parameters specific to FastAPI WebSocket implementation.

classes.name: main
classes.description: Main entry point to run the script or instantiate the bot.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function to simulate fetching weather data based on requested format.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function to simulate retrieving a restaurant suggestion.

methods.name: end_conversation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function to conclude the conversation gracefully.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up tools, LLM, pipeline, and handles the bot's main event loop.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point function to set up the transport and start the bot.
